land.label: Land, about 2.7 acres on US 377
land.assumption: The October 2026 asking price the research found for a commercial corner of about 2.7 acres on US 377, about $521,626 an acre. The listing is not cited so that no real parcel is identified, and an appraisal sets the value.

site_work.label: Paving, drainage, fencing, gate, lighting, wash bay and dump station
site_work.assumption: No local site cost was found. A builder puts site development at $4.25 to $8 per square foot beyond construction and a fenced, paved outdoor facility at about $15 per square foot (August 2025) [^41]. The line uses the top of the site-development range across the whole unimproved lot, because Granbury's code requires an improved hard surface for vehicle storage [^5], and it includes the gate, lighting, wash bay and dump station.

canopies.label: Steel canopies over the covered spaces
canopies.assumption: Canopy structures cost $9 to $14 or more per structural square foot and about $36 per square foot turnkey (2025) [^40]; a Mountain West builder quotes covered shells at $18 to $35 per rentable square foot (2026) [^42]. The line assumes about 12 by 45 foot covered spaces priced between those ranges; steel and aluminum prices rose sharply into mid-2026 [^51].

soft.label: Design, permits, SUP process and contingency
soft.assumption: Permitting and professional services run $1 to $3 per square foot (August 2025) [^41]. The line adds the Specific Use Permit process the Heavy Commercial district requires for vehicle storage [^5,6] and a construction contingency.

covered_spaces.label: Covered spaces
covered_spaces.assumption: After drive aisles, setbacks, the wash bay and the gate, the lot holds about 100 spaces, fewer than the 40 spaces per acre Cushman & Wakefield uses for supply estimates (December 2025) [^34]. Most are covered because covered spaces carry the rent premium in Granbury's posted rates [^10,14].

open_spaces.label: Open spaces
open_spaces.assumption: The balance of the roughly 100 spaces, on paved open stalls for boat trailers and smaller RVs.

covered_rate.label: Covered rent per space per month, Year 1
covered_rate.assumption: Park'er Here posts covered spaces from $90 (32 feet) to $175 (65 feet), with 45 and 50 feet at $120 and $135; A&E posts a 45-foot covered space at $128; Vanguard says its largest covered pull-through spaces are under $150 (all checked October 15, 2026) [^10,11,14]. A new facility is priced at the 50-foot level.

open_rate.label: Open rent per space per month, Year 1
open_rate.assumption: Park'er Here posts outside RV parking at $50 and open boat trailers at $40; A&E posts uncovered spaces at $46 (checked October 15, 2026) [^10,14].

rent_growth.label: Annual rent growth
rent_growth.assumption: Equals the Dallas-Fort Worth year-over-year parking rent change Yardi Matrix reported for September 2025 [^33]. National rents rose faster, but every Park'er Here size showed available on October 15, 2026 [^10], which argues against faster increases.

occupancy.label: Average occupancy
occupancy.assumption: No primary absorption benchmark was found. The ramp reaches 88% by Year 4, near the 8.5% vacancy a large Florida facility carried in its 2023 CMBS underwriting [^43]. A 2025 Florida opening leased faster than its own projection [^45], but open capacity at Granbury operators in October 2026 [^10,14] argues for a slower first year.

mgmt_pct.label: Management fee, share of revenue
mgmt_pct.assumption: Third-party self-storage managers typically charge 6% of gross revenue (2019) [^44].

fixed_opex.label: Insurance, utilities, repairs, software and marketing, Year 1
fixed_opex.assumption: Insurance, utilities, repairs, software and marketing for a gated facility without on-site staff. No local cost was found; local operators market hail and ice-storm protection [^11], so storm insurance is a real line. A large Florida facility ran total operating expenses of $0.90 per square foot in its 2023 underwriting [^43].

cost_growth.label: Annual growth in fixed costs
cost_growth.assumption: General allowance; no local cost series was found.

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: A broker rate sheet quoted 10-year fixed self-storage loans at 7.03% on July 27, 2026 [^47]. The bank's 504 first lien at half of cost is no riskier, so the same rate is used. The lender sets the rate at pricing

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank first-lien amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: Matches the 25-year debenture term; the bank's term must meet SBA's minimum for a 25-year debenture [^53].

revenue.label: Covered space rent
revenue.basis: spaces x rent x 12 x occupancy

revenue.label: Open space rent
revenue.basis: spaces x rent x 12 x occupancy
